items.name: Finnish FMC Series VIII 2025
items.information: **This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.** Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. **Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.** Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: Flushing Glow at Night 2025
items.information: Please note that this competition takes place on a **Friday evening.** See the schedule for the exact times/details. This competition is sponsored by the Glow Cultural Center, which provides cultural, wellness, and youth development programs and serves as a hub for community activity. Glow aims to serve the multi-cultural population of the community, including but not limited to the under-served new immigrant, low-income households residing in Flushing and nearby communities. All proceeds from this competition will go to the Glow Cultural Center. Please see the Sponsor/Fundraiser tab for more details.

items.name: New York Multimate PBQ II 2025
items.information: This competition only has blind events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in New York](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=New+York&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
